contractFactsImplemented: Production OpenSpec observation exposes only closed read-only list/status observations and no generic arbitrary-command executor.

OpenSpec invocation consumes only the exact managed openspec runtime, current host Node, argument-array process execution and canonical requested repository cwd; PATH/global/shell executable selection is not used.
Successful observations exact-bind OpenSpec root.path to the canonical requested repository root and reject nearest-root drift.
Non-zero exit with valid JSON remains a closed openspec-formal-outcome diagnostic distinct from process, malformed-output, invalid-shape and root-mismatch failures.
Active OpenSpec Change observation projects only canonical Change identifiers and does not interpret them as Flowkit ChangeState.
Exact Change status projects only change identity, schema/change root, planning/complete booleans and artifact id/status/requires/missingDeps machine facts.
Artifact readiness is accepted from OpenSpec machine output and is not re-derived from Markdown/filesystem state.
Observations are transient and add no .flowkit OpenSpec-state mirror, Policy/authority coupling, OpenSpec mutation, .agents runtime dependency, Skill migration or self-hosting behavior.
limitations: Independent review-apply has not yet been performed.
This Apply grants no Verification PASS, Owner archive authority, checkpoint authority or promotion authority.
Current .agents OpenSpec Skills remain bootstrap development orchestration only; production observation does not depend on them.
Foundation CLI, mutating OpenSpec integration and Flowkit self-hosting remain outside this Change.
